storybound.dev.scene_view.axis_0: Right of the anchor (negative: left). Drag the slider or type the number
storybound.dev.scene_view.axis_1: Up from the anchor's feet. Drag the slider or type the number
storybound.dev.scene_view.axis_2: In front of the anchor (negative: behind). Drag the slider or type the number
storybound.dev.scene_view.length_tooltip: Seconds the flight takes, or blocks a second (then it lasts as long as the way takes). Click to switch
storybound.dev.scene_view.ease_in_out: Flight: speeds up, then slows down
storybound.dev.scene_view.ease_tooltip: How the flight speeds up and slows down. Click to switch
storybound.dev.scene_view.look_path: Camera looks: the way it flies
storybound.dev.scene_view.look_tooltip: Where the camera looks while it flies. Click to switch
storybound.dev.scene_view.pilot_already_: This point already moves live with WASD and mouse
storybound.dev.scene_view.capture_needs_: Press Step out of camera (Tab), frame your angle, then press 📷
storybound.dev.scene_view.unlocked_free_: Switched look to Free (Ctrl+Z to undo)
storybound.dev.scene_view.mode_hint_pilo: LMB: orbit target · RMB: free aim
storybound.dev.scene_view.mode_hint_shot: Click Start/End to move with WASD
storybound.dev.scene_view.help_close: Press F1, Esc, or click the viewport to close
storybound.dev.scene_view.help_sec_pilot: Framing a point (live by default on Start / End):
storybound.dev.scene_view.help_pilot_1: • WASD — fly · Space / E — up · Shift / Q — down · Ctrl — 3x speed
storybound.dev.scene_view.help_pilot_2: • LMB — Blender orbit/grab · Shift+LMB / MMB — pan · RMB — FPS look
storybound.dev.scene_view.help_pilot_3: • Wheel — dolly · Alt+wheel — FOV · [ / ] — switch point
storybound.dev.scene_view.help_sec_outsi: Outside camera (Tab) — inspect the path from outside:
storybound.dev.scene_view.help_outside_1: • WASD + Space/Shift (E/Q) — fly freely without moving points
storybound.dev.scene_view.help_outside_2: • Drag a camera pyramid to move it (+Shift — along the ground)
storybound.dev.scene_view.help_outside_3: • K (or Camera button) — capture exact frame (pos + view) · F — focus
storybound.dev.scene_view.help_playback_: • Enter — play shot from any mode (Space also plays in preview)
• ←/→ (+Shift) step · RMB timeline: + cue / − mark · H panel · G grid
storybound.dev.scene_view.help_edit_1: • Mouse wheel over any number or slider (+Shift — 10x step)
storybound.dev.scene_view.help_edit_2: • Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y — undo / redo · Ctrl+S — save
storybound.dev.scene_view.rot_tooltip: Camera viewing angle at this point (yaw relative to anchor, pitch -90..90). Scroll to nudge
storybound.dev.scene_view.rot_aim_anchor: Aim this point straight at the anchor
storybound.dev.scene_view.shake_tooltip: Subtle organic camera breathing (0.02–0.05 for cinema handheld feel). Scroll to nudge
storybound.dev.scene_view.hint_pilot: WASD + Space/Shift (E/Q): move · LMB: orbit · RMB: look · Alt+wheel: FOV · Tab: step out · Enter: play · F1: hotkeys
storybound.dev.scene_view.add: A new shot after this one, starting where this one ends
storybound.dev.scene_view.copy: A copy of this shot after it
storybound.dev.scene_view.swap_tooltip: Swap Start and End: the same flight backwards
storybound.dev.scene_view.nudge_tooltip: Type it, or turn the wheel over it
storybound.dev.scene_view.here_tooltip: Available outside the camera (Tab): captures BOTH exact position and viewing direction onto this point (key K)
storybound.dev.scene_view.transition_cut: From the last shot: a cut
storybound.dev.scene_view.transition_fad: From the last shot: through black
storybound.dev.scene_view.transition_eas: From the last shot: a glide
storybound.dev.scene_view.transition_too: How this shot follows the one before it. Click to switch
storybound.dev.scene_view.play_tooltip: Plays this shot (Enter, or Space while previewing)
storybound.dev.scene_view.play_scene_too: Plays the whole scene, shot after shot, with its cuts, fades and glides
storybound.dev.scene_view.free_tooltip: Step out of the camera lens to see the full flight path and camera pyramids (flying here does not move points; 📷/K captures frame). Tab returns into the camera
storybound.dev.scene_view.grid_tooltip: Lines of thirds over the picture, to place what matters (G)
storybound.dev.scene_view.save_tooltip: Writes the scene (Ctrl+S); the view stays open
storybound.dev.scene_view.unsaved: Changes are not saved. Save them, or press Close again to leave them.
storybound.dev.scene_view.hint_shot: Preview · Space/Enter: play · ←/→: step · [ / ]: edit point · Tab: step out · F1: hotkeys
storybound.dev.scene_view.hint_free: Outside camera · WASD + Space/Shift (E/Q): fly · LMB: orbit/handles · RMB: look · 📷/K: capture · Tab: back to camera · F1: hotkeys
storybound.dev.scene_view.hint_scene: The whole scene · %s of %s s · Space: pause
storybound.dev.scene_view.cue_music: A track: its id, or … to pick
storybound.dev.scene_view.cue_add_toolti: Add a thing in the shot at the exact moment shown now (press again to stack another kind at the same second)
storybound.dev.scene_view.cue_none: Press + above or right-click the time line below to add a thing; click a mark on the time line to pick one.
storybound.dev.scene_view.not_saved: Not saved, kept as a draft: %s
storybound.dev.scene_view.cue_remove: Remove this thing (a right click on its mark does the same)
storybound.dev.scene_view.cue_sound: A sound: its id, or … to pick
storybound.dev.scene_view.fade_style_too: Starts black (in = 0s) is best at the start of a shot so it reveals out of darkness without flashing first. Click to switch
storybound.dev.scene_view.talk: A talk: %s. The dialogue plays with its own camera, the anchor is the one spoken to; the scene goes on after it.
storybound.dev.vanilla_script.nobody: It never runs by itself, and nothing runs it yet
storybound.dev.vanilla_script.run_by: Run by %s nodes: see Links below
storybound.dev.vanilla_script.run_in_too: Pick what runs the script: a quest's start, the end of a talk or a story event (with its own condition). To take it out: ✕ in Links below
storybound.dev.vanilla_script.more: … and %s more errors (all of them in the story check)
storybound.dev.vanilla_script.syntax: ~ ~ ~ is where it runs · wait 2 pauses · # is a note
storybound.dev.script.pick_file_tooltip: Pick the script from the server's kubejs/server_scripts
storybound.dev.script.open_tooltip: Open the file in your editor (singleplayer)
storybound.dev.script.create_tooltip: Writes kubejs/server_scripts/%s registering this handler and reloads; an existing file is never changed
storybound.dev.script.derived: From the script: no block file (Save writes one)
storybound.dev.status.script_hidden: Script block taken off the canvas; its code stays in KubeJS
storybound.dev.script.state.no_kubejs: KubeJS is not installed on the server
storybound.dev.script.state.no_file: No file yet: pick one or make a new one
storybound.dev.script.state.file_missing: ✗ The file is not on the server
storybound.dev.status.hook_renamed: The handler changed: %s nodes now run %s
storybound.dev.giver.title: Quest giver: %s
storybound.dev.giver.create_tooltip.befo: A dialogue the NPC says before the quest (while it is unknown)
storybound.dev.giver.create_tooltip.duri: A dialogue the NPC says while the quest is active
storybound.dev.giver.create_tooltip.afte: A dialogue the NPC says once the quest is completed
storybound.dev.status.script_on_server: The file is on the server: %s
storybound.dev.form.waypoint_color.toolt: Colours the marker, its name, the arrow at the screen edge, a search area's ring and the waypoint on the maps; these look the same in the world, in Xaero and in JourneyMap. Another colour can be written in the file as #RRGGBB.
storybound.dev.form.trace.tooltip: Walk the trail from its start to its end: a point every 2 blocks while you are on the ground or swimming. Click to finish where it leads, ESC to cancel. It shows only within 11 blocks of a player, as glowing motes rising from the steps.
storybound.dev.trace.rule.tooltip: Recorded: you walk the trail and it stays as you laid it. Dynamic: a creature's real steps, found as the game goes. Click to switch.
storybound.dev.trace.tracks.note: Its real steps on ground that takes tracks (earth, sand, snow), the last 5 minutes: they break off on stone, and there are none while it flies or swims.
storybound.dev.trace.recording_hint: %s points · click to finish · ESC to cancel
storybound.dev.trace.other_dimension: A trail stays in one dimension: the recording was cancelled
storybound.dev.check.waypoint.trace: Record the trail: walk it from its start to its end
storybound.dev.form.waypoint_kind.toolti: A target is a point, marked with the diamond. A search area is a circle with a radius: the magnifier, its radius by the name and its edge on the ground, each of which can be turned off. A trail is dashes on the ground leading somewhere, with no marker at all: found and followed near it, never seen from afar. Click to switch.
storybound.dev.form.difficulty.stars: Click: the next number of stars (1 to 5), then unset. The scale is set in project.json
storybound.dev.form.difficulty.levels: Click: the next level of the scale, then unset. The levels are set in project.json
storybound.dev.form.pick_block: Pick a place in the world
storybound.dev.form.pick_entity: Point at an entity in the world
storybound.dev.text.hint: Write the text here; the markup is below
storybound.dev.status.preview_unsaved: Save the document first, then preview it
storybound.dev.quest.starts_none: Nothing yet: a dialogue, a story event or an action can give it
storybound.dev.quest.no_objectives: No objectives: an action moves it on
storybound.dev.progress.tooltip: A player's progress on the map: quests they do not know are dimmed, ✔ done, ▶ the stage they are at, ✘ failed. Click: the next player
storybound.dev.relationship.used: The scale stays on: the story uses it in %s. Take those lines out first
storybound.dev.relationship.tooltip: A number per player, from 0: %s. On, actions offer +10 / -10 and conditions at least 20 / at most -20. Off removes it, if nothing uses it
storybound.dev.picker.aim: Aim and click; ESC goes back
storybound.dev.form.no_schema: Another mod's type: its fields as JSON.
storybound.dev.help.condition.flag: The flag equals value; an unset flag is false.
storybound.dev.help.condition.var: Compares a story variable with a value.
storybound.dev.help.condition.has_item: At least count matching items in the whole inventory.
storybound.dev.help.condition.location: Every given part matches: dimension, biome, area, structure.
storybound.dev.help.condition.in_party: In a real party of at least min_size members.
storybound.dev.help.condition.all: Every condition in the list passes.
storybound.dev.help.condition.any: At least one condition in the list passes.
storybound.dev.help.condition.kubejs: A predicate a KubeJS script or a mod registered under this id.
storybound.dev.help.condition.document_r: The player read the document at least once.
storybound.dev.help.condition.quest: The quest is in this state; with stage, active at that stage.
storybound.dev.help.condition.codex_unlo: The entry (or that section) is open for the player.
storybound.dev.help.condition.boss_kille: At least count victories over the boss.
storybound.dev.help.condition.time: A period of the day, or ticks min..max (over midnight when min > max).
storybound.dev.help.condition.weather: Clear, rain (snow too) or thunder in the player's dimension.
storybound.dev.help.condition.advancemen: The player has it ("done: no": has not).
storybound.dev.help.condition.stat: A vanilla statistic is at least the value: minecraft:mob_kills, or a type and an id (minecraft:killed + minecraft:zombie).
storybound.dev.help.action.set_var: Writes a value: true/false, a whole number or text.
storybound.dev.help.action.add_var: Adds amount to a number (negative subtracts).
storybound.dev.help.action.give_item: Gives items; what does not fit drops. Pick the held item to keep its enchantments and name.
storybound.dev.help.action.take_item: All or nothing: with too few it takes none and fails. Put it before rewards.
storybound.dev.help.action.spawn_entity: At a place or next to the player; a tag lets a waypoint or an NPC binding find it.
storybound.dev.help.action.teleport: The player or the entity of the moment, also to another dimension.
storybound.dev.help.action.effect: For some seconds (-1: forever); "clear" takes it away.
storybound.dev.type.action.title: Title on screen
storybound.dev.help.action.title: A big title, a subtitle and the line above the hotbar.
storybound.dev.help.action.wait: The actions after it run that many seconds later, even after a restart.
storybound.dev.help.action.schedule: Its own actions run that many seconds later; the list goes on at once.
storybound.dev.help.action.play_cutscene: A Cutscene API cutscene (needs the mod).
storybound.dev.help.condition.in_cutscen: Any cutscene without an id; false without Cutscene API.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.cutscene_fin: finish: played to the end; interrupt, command, error: stopped.
storybound.dev.field.subtitle: Subtitle
storybound.dev.help.action.run_command: Run at the player (@s is the player), output hidden.
storybound.dev.help.action.kubejs: An action a KubeJS script or a mod registered under this id.
storybound.dev.help.action.journal_entry: Writes or replaces a note in the Journal.
storybound.dev.help.action.notify: A toast on the player's screen.
storybound.dev.help.action.set_quest_sta: active starts it, completed finishes it with rewards, unknown resets it.
Moves the quest to the stage, starting it if needed.
storybound.dev.help.action.track_quest: Shows the quest on the HUD; without quest, nothing.
storybound.dev.help.action.start_dialogu: The NPC of the moment becomes its speaker.
storybound.dev.help.action.end_dialogue: Ends it as finished, so 'dialogue ended' fires.
storybound.dev.help.action.open_trade: Ends the dialogue and opens the NPC's trades ("show me your wares").
storybound.dev.help.action.unlock_codex: Opens a section, or every section without one.
storybound.dev.help.action.unlock_boss_s: Opens lore, tactics or rewards of a boss.
storybound.dev.help.action.add_waypoint: At pos, following the NPC, at the nearest structure, or where the NPC stands.
storybound.dev.help.action.remove_waypoi: Removes the waypoint added with this id.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.flag_changed: The value changes (to value, if given).
storybound.dev.help.trigger.entity_inter: The player right-clicks such an entity.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.entity_seen: The player sees such an entity (once until it leaves).
storybound.dev.help.trigger.entity_kille: The player deals the killing blow; with shared, a party member nearby counts too; with "Whoever kills it", every player nearby, whatever killed it.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.area_entered: The player walks into the sphere.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.structure_en: The player comes within such a structure.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.biome_entere: The player walks into such a biome.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.time: Night (or day, sunset, sunrise) begins where the player is. A stage that begins already at night counts at once.
storybound.dev.help.action.fade: The screen fades to a colour and back: a time cut, waking up, the start of a scene.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.poi_entered: The player comes within radius of a bell, a job site, a bed…
storybound.dev.help.trigger.party_left: Left, was kicked, or the party was disbanded.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.logged_in: The player joined the server or opened the world; first_time: only their first visit.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.custom: Fired by a KubeJS script, a mod or /storybound debug trigger fire with this id.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.advancement_: Without an id: any advancement with a toast.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.level_reache: Fires when the level crosses the value, not for players already past it.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.stat_reached: Like the Statistic condition, when the value is crossed.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.document_rea: Every read; first_time only the first.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.quest_stage_: To stage, if given, the first stage too.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.dialogue_end: Finished, not interrupted; node: the last one passed.
storybound.dev.help.action.play_scene: The player watches the scene; while they talk or watch another one, it waits its turn.
storybound.dev.help.trigger.scene_finish: A scene the player watched is over: played to the end, or cut short by a death or a teleport. For an objective "Watch the scene".
storybound.dev.help.condition.in_scene: The player watches the scene now (any scene without one picked).
storybound.dev.help.trigger.boss_killed: Every credited player; first_time only the first victory.
storybound.dev.field.add_on_read: Goes to the journal when read
storybound.dev.phrases.choose_tooltip: Pick a phrases node (says a random or ordered bubble line each click; press + beside it to create one now)
storybound.dev.phrases.open_node: Open this phrases node to edit its lines
storybound.dev.phrases.create_tooltip: Create a new random phrases node and open it
storybound.dev.phrases.mode.tooltip: Click: a single text written here, or a phrases node (random or ordered bubble lines)
storybound.dev.phrases.mode.tooltip_dial: Click to switch: a dialogue, a phrases node (random or ordered bubble lines on each click), or a single text
storybound.dev.phrases.usage.title: Used by NPCs
storybound.dev.phrases.usage.empty: No NPC uses these phrases yet
storybound.dev.phrases.usage.add_tooltip: Assign these phrases to an NPC (on click as a bubble, or as ambient chatter)
storybound.dev.phrases.pick_dialogue: The dialogue: click to pick another
storybound.dev.field.home_radius: Walks from home up to, blocks
storybound.dev.field.by_mobs: Also when a mob hurts it
storybound.dev.value.order.sequence: in order, stays on the last
storybound.dev.value.order.loop: round (top to bottom, again and again)
storybound.dev.field.content: Text of another document (empty: its own)
storybound.dev.field.duration: Moves on by itself after, s
storybound.dev.entity.tag_filter.tooltip: A tag the story put on them (spawn_entity's tag) or /tag. Empty: any of them.
storybound.dev.entity.link: Link an entity in the world
storybound.dev.entity.link.tooltip: Click an entity in the world: it gets the tag %s and becomes this NPC
storybound.dev.entity.summary.name: name «%s»
storybound.dev.field.name: Name
storybound.dev.field.proximity: Speaks up when a player comes near
storybound.dev.field.waypoint.name: Name above the marker
storybound.dev.value.marker.question: A question (?)
storybound.dev.value.marker.point.toolti: The usual icon: the diamond for a target, the magnifier for a search area.
storybound.dev.value.marker.event.toolti: Three "!" hopping: something is happening there.
storybound.dev.value.marker.question.too: A "?" shaking now and then: something unknown is there.
storybound.dev.value.marker.tracks.toolt: Glowing sparks rise from the steps, a step about every block.
storybound.dev.value.marker.scent.toolti: Wisps of coloured smoke drift along the trail the way it leads, over any ground, like a scent in the air.

storybound.dev.value.bound: the NPC it is started with
scenario.reputation.hint: Talk to Hilda the baker (play in survival). Compliment her (+10) or be rude (-10); offer help and accept (husks come: kill three in a minute for +20, or let the time run out for -20) or refuse (-10). Your standing shows top left: a star for every 10 above 0, a skull for every 10 below, -50 to 50. She greets and chatters differently from 30 and from -20.
scenario.reputation.chatter.oven: The oven never sleeps, and neither do I.
scenario.reputation.chatter.flour: Something has been at my flour again...
scenario.reputation.chatter.warm1: Oh, it's you! I've put a loaf aside for you.
scenario.reputation.greet: Welcome to my bakery. What can I do for you?
scenario.reputation.greet_warm: There you are! Come in, come in — the best bun is yours.
scenario.reputation.greet_cold: You again... What do you want?
scenario.reputation.ask.busy: I'm still dealing with the husks.
scenario.reputation.thanks: Oh, thank you! That warms my heart more than the oven.
scenario.reputation.hurt: How dare you! I was up before dawn kneading that!
scenario.reputation.task: Husks have got into my barn and are eating the flour. Could you drive off three of them? Quickly, please — within a minute!
scenario.reputation.glad: Bless you! Hurry, they're by the barn!
scenario.reputation.sigh: I see... Well, never mind then.
scenario.reputation.hurry: Hurry, they're chewing through the sacks!
scenario.reputation.quest.title: Uninvited guests
scenario.reputation.quest.intro: Husks in the barn. Hilda counts on you.
scenario.reputation.quest.text: Husks are eating the flour in Hilda's barn. Drive them off before it is all gone.
scenario.reputation.quest.done: The barn is safe. Hilda will not forget it.
scenario.reputation.quest.failed: Too late: the husks ate the flour. Hilda is disappointed.
scenario.campfire.hint: Talk to Brann the golem (play in survival). Husks will come: let him fight, the story waits.
scenario.campfire.story.l1: Sit down, traveller. I'll tell you how I lost my arm. Well, a lump of iron.
scenario.campfire.story.l2: It was in the Wastes, twenty winters ago. The sand there sings at night.
scenario.campfire.story.l3: We walked with a caravan, and then, out of the dunes...
scenario.campfire.story.l4: ...they rose. Hundreds. No, thousands! The sand itself got up and walked.
scenario.campfire.story.l5: I held the pass until dawn. When the sun came up, my arm stayed in the sand.
scenario.campfire.story.l6: Then a smith from the village made me a new one. Better than the old.
scenario.campfire.story.l7: Maybe. But the husks you just met were real, weren't they?
scenario.campfire.story.where_sands: Yes, the sand. I remember the sand.
scenario.campfire.quest.title: Story by the Fire
scenario.campfire.quest.text: Brann the golem wants to tell a story. A fight will interrupt him; he picks it up after.
scenario.campfire.brann_hit: Hey! You don't hit your own!
scenario.campfire.chatter.wastes: The Wastes don't forgive the careless.
scenario.campfire.chatter.story: Want a story? Sit down, talk to me.
scenario.campfire.hit.again: Once more and I'll take offence.
scenario.village.hint: Follow the marker to the nearest village and talk to Elder Miron: his answers give quests, a dragon hunt and an old map for 5 emeralds. Your Journal already has a letter, a reward to claim, Codex entries and boss pages. Every villager gets a name and chatter, smiths and about every third grown-up (a guard) their own. This is every villager of the world until /storybound debug scenario clear.
scenario.village.chatter.elder: Heard? The elder is in a mood again.
scenario.village.elder.l1: I am Miron, the elder of this village. Were you sent to me?
scenario.village.elder.p1: I'm looking for whoever is in charge here.
scenario.village.elder.l2: You found him. Sit down, traveller. What brings you here?
scenario.village.quest.title: The village elder
scenario.village.quest.text: Find a village and its elder: the marker leads to the nearest village, then to him.
scenario.village.quest.done: I spoke with Miron. The village has more troubles than a letter could tell.
scenario.village.quest.log.reach: A letter asks me to find Miron, the elder of the nearest village.
scenario.village.quest.log.find: I reached the village. Now to find the elder among the villagers.
scenario.village.elder.opt_dragon: They say a dragon sleeps beyond the End.
scenario.village.elder.opt_map: Sell me that old map. (5 emeralds)
scenario.village.elder.trouble: Zombies come every night, the baker has nothing left to bake, and a lamb ran off into the fields. We are farmers, not fighters.
scenario.village.elder.trouble_end: Help us, and the village will not forget it.
scenario.village.elder.dragon: Old tales. Find the stronghold under the earth, gather twelve eyes, and the way opens. Or so my grandfather said.
scenario.village.elder.dragon_end: If you go, go ready. No one has come back from there.
scenario.village.elder.map_end: Here. It was my father's. I never dared to follow it.
scenario.village.raiders.title: Night raiders
scenario.village.raiders.text: The dead come to the village every night. Thin their numbers, by your hand or the golem's.
scenario.village.raiders.log: Miron asked me to deal with the zombies that come at night. Any that die near me count.
scenario.village.raiders.hint: They only come out at night.
scenario.village.bread.title: Bread for the winter
scenario.village.bread.text: The baker is out of flour. Bring bread for the village stores.
scenario.village.bread.done: The stores are full for the winter.
scenario.village.bread.log: The village needs bread before the cold comes.
scenario.village.lamb.title: The lost lamb
scenario.village.lamb.text: A lamb ran off into the fields around the village.
scenario.village.lamb.log: Somewhere in the fields around the village there is a lost lamb.
scenario.village.dragon.title: Beyond the End
scenario.village.dragon.text: Miron's tales speak of a dragon beyond a portal deep under the earth.
scenario.village.dragon.done: The dragon is dead. The tale has an ending now.
scenario.village.dragon.log.stronghold: According to the tale, the way to the End starts in a stronghold under the earth.
scenario.village.dragon.log.eyes: I found the stronghold. The portal frame has empty sockets: twelve eyes are needed.
scenario.village.dragon.log.dragon: The portal is ready. Beyond it waits the dragon.
scenario.village.gift.title: The elder's welcome
scenario.village.gift.text: Miron sent a gift with his letter. Claim it in the Journal.
scenario.village.letter.title: A letter from Miron
scenario.village.map.title: An old map
scenario.dimensions.hint: A quest with markers in three dimensions, pinned. Here in the Overworld only the village marker shows; the tracker says "📍 The Nether, The End". Go into the Nether and reach the fortress: its marker appears a few seconds after you arrive, low while far and in its middle once near, and the tracker says "📍 The Overworld, The End". The End is never searched until you are there. Once you reach the fortress, come back to the Overworld to complete the quest.
scenario.dimensions.quest.title: Between worlds
scenario.dimensions.quest.text: Markers in the Overworld, the Nether and the End: each shows only in its own dimension, the tracker says where the others are.
scenario.duel.hint: Ataman Grom comes for you (play in survival). Fight him: he keeps talking all through the fight, the dialogue does not stop for it. Beat him to hear his last words.
scenario.duel.taunts.l1: So you're the hero they all whisper about? Draw your blade.
scenario.duel.taunts.l2: Too slow! My grandmother swings faster.
scenario.duel.taunts.l3: Not bad... for a village bumpkin.
scenario.duel.taunts.l4: You think the elder will pay you? He pays me too!
scenario.duel.taunts.l6: Still standing? Stubborn as a mule...
scenario.duel.fallen.l1: You... are better than they said...
scenario.duel.quest.title: The Duel
scenario.duel.quest.text: Ataman Grom wants a fight, and he never shuts up.
scenario.duel.taunts.p1: They say you talk a lot, Ataman.
scenario.duel.taunts.p2: At least your grandmother keeps quiet.
scenario.duel.taunts.p3: Then I'll have a word with the elder after you.
scenario.raid.hint: A raid that comes back now and then (play in survival). It turns the time to day; run /time set 14000: night falls, three pillagers with the tag scenario_raider come with a "!" marker, and the quest "Night raid" starts. Kill them: the quest is done only when none of them is left within 48 blocks of the last one killed; wild pillagers do not count. Then /time set day and /time set 14000 again within two minutes: no raid, it is cooling down (/storybound debug trace says how long is left). After two minutes of play the next night brings a new raid. In the editor: the events start and attack (its cooldown) and the quest's objective (entity_killed with a selector, the entities condition).
scenario.raid.quest.title: Night raid
scenario.raid.quest.text: Raiders came out of the night. Drive them off, every last one.
scenario.raid.quest.done: The raiders are gone. They may come back on another night.
scenario.scene.hint: A scene of three shots plays at once: the camera circles you with the black bars and a chapter title, comes close for a line, then glides up and away. You cannot move while it plays; Space skips it, and Escape opens the pause menu and the scene goes on after. Nothing can hurt you meanwhile. When it is over, the quest "Watch the scene" is done: its objective waits for scene_finished. In the editor: scenes/scenario/scene/demo.json.
scenario.scene.line: Every road begins somewhere. This one begins here.
scenario.scene.line_two: And the world is wider than it looks from the ground.
scenario.scene.quest.title: Watch the scene
scenario.scene.quest.text: A scene plays; this quest waits for its end.
scenario.scene.quest.watch: Watch the scene to the end
scenario.scene.quest.done: The scene played to its end.

storybound.dev.projects.delete.tooltip: Its folder moves to config/storybound/.deleted; nothing is erased
storybound.dev.projects.delete_last: The last story cannot be deleted: make another first
